title: Webinar video and slides available
summary: Video and slides are available from our February 10, 2022 webinar on the in-development Variant Sifter tool.
bodyHtml: On February 10, 2022 we presented a webinar introducing the in-development Variant Sifter tool, which allows you to explore, filter, and prioritize genetically associated variants across a region along with credible sets and epigenomic annotations. View the video here, or download the slide deck.
